subject.note: Junior-high coverage of this existing tutoring category. SHS uses distinct courses and electives; Grades 11–12 are not inferred from this JHS label. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Whole Numbers & Operations.note: Mathematics pp. 52–54: rational numbers and integers. Whole-number arithmetic is prerequisite review, not a new Grade 7 competency. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Fractions & Decimals.note: Mathematics p. 52: expressing rational numbers as fractions, decimals and percentages, and operations on rational numbers. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Algebraic Expressions.note: Mathematics pp. 55–56: simple equations, algebraic expressions, polynomial operations and factoring. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Linear Equations & Inequalities.note: Mathematics p. 55: simple equations; pp. 58–59: linear equations, systems and inequalities. Grade 7 covers the introductory equations part only. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Geometry & Measurement.note: Mathematics pp. 52–68: polygons, measurement, volume, geometry, triangles and coordinate geometry, with different subtopics by grade. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Statistics & Probability.note: Mathematics pp. 23–24 grade-level standards and pp. 54, 56, 59, 64, 66: statistical data/graphs (Grade 7), descriptive statistics/probability (Grade 8), simple/compound events and interpreting data (Grade 9), and statistical distributions/probability (Grade 10). Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Trigonometry.note: Mathematics pp. 64–65: right-triangle trigonometric ratios in Grade 9; laws of sines and cosines in Grade 10. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Functions & Graphing.note: Mathematics pp. 57–58, 60, 62–63, 65–67: coordinate plane and linear graphs (Grade 8); linear/quadratic functions (Grade 9); further coordinate graphs (Grade 10). Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

subject.note: Junior-high coverage of this existing tutoring category. SHS uses distinct courses and electives; Grades 11–12 are not inferred from this JHS label. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Grammar & Sentence Structure.note: English Grades 7–10 sections, pp. 143–185: language features and sentence construction are embedded in text analysis and composition. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Reading Comprehension.note: English Grades 7–10 sections, pp. 143–185: interpreting literary and informational texts. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Vocabulary Building.note: English Grades 7–10 sections, pp. 143–185: word choice, vocabulary, and language features in context. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Essay & Paragraph Writing.note: English Grades 7–10 sections, pp. 143–185: composing and revising literary/informational texts; text type varies by grade. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Literature Analysis.note: English Grades 7–10 sections, pp. 143–185: literary analysis; national/regional/world literature coverage varies. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Public Speaking & Oral Communication.note: English Grades 7–10 sections, pp. 143–185: delivery, presentation and multimodal communication; this is a tutoring umbrella, not the SHS course title. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Research Writing.note: English pp. 151, 162, 173: research language and academic exposition in Grades 7–9; pp. 180–184: Grade 10 research reports based on literature review. Complexity differs by grade. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

subject.note: Junior-high coverage of this existing tutoring category. SHS uses distinct courses and electives; Grades 11–12 are not inferred from this JHS label. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Scientific Method & Inquiry.note: Science pp. 46–66: inquiry and investigations are embedded across grade-level science domains. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Cell Biology & Genetics.note: Science pp. 47, 51, 59: cells/reproduction (Grade 7), inheritance (Grade 8), DNA and mutations (Grade 9). The combined label spans different competencies. Grade 10 p. 67 extends heredity through evolution and biotechnology; the cell-biology part is foundational. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Chemical Reactions & Matter.note: Science pp. 46, 52, 60, 64–65: particle model/matter (Grade 7), atomic model (Grade 8), bonding/new substances (Grade 9), chemical reactions (Grade 10). Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Force, Motion & Energy.note: Science pp. 48, 54–56, 63: forces and motion progress across all four grades. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Ecosystems & the Environment.note: Science pp. 47, 51, 59, 61–62, 67: food webs, cycles, biodiversity, climate/environment, and life-science applications. Subtopics differ by grade. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Earth & Space Science.note: Science pp. 49–50, 53, 57–58, 61–62: earthquakes, Earth systems, solar system, tectonics and climate. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Human Body Systems.note: Science p. 51: digestive/excretory systems and organ systems working together (Grade 8); p. 67: homeostasis and feedback across human body systems (Grade 10). Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

subject.note: Junior-high coverage of this existing tutoring category. SHS uses distinct courses and electives; Grades 11–12 are not inferred from this JHS label. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Balarila (Gramatika).note: Filipino pp. 118–171: linguistic elements and communicative use are embedded in texts; this is not a separate grammar course. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Pagbasa at Pag-unawa.note: Filipino pp. 118–171: comprehension and analysis of literary, informational and visual texts. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Panitikang Pilipino.note: Filipino pp. 122–156: Philippine literary periods and works in Grades 7–9. Grade 10 focuses on world literature, so it is not automatically included under this specifically Philippine label. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Pagsulat ng Sanaysay.note: Filipino pp. 122–156: essay composition and multimodal essay tasks. Grade 10 emphasizes other outputs, including research proposals. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Pagsasalin.note: Legacy Filipino 10 supplementary DLP explicitly teaches translation. Not located as an explicit competency in the inspected revised Filipino guide; retain for review and flag as legacy, not current verified coverage.

Retorika at Pampublikong Pagsasalita.note: Filipino pp. 134–171: persuasive/argumentative texts, speech/debate and presentations. Broad tutoring label; exact genre differs by grade. The current Grade 7 BOW also includes speeches (talumpati) among informational text examples; this is introductory text work, not a full rhetoric course. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

subject.note: Junior-high coverage of this existing tutoring category. SHS uses distinct courses and electives; Grades 11–12 are not inferred from this JHS label. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Kasaysayan ng Pilipinas.note: AP Grade 7: Philippines in Southeast Asia, including historical connections, colonialism, nationalism and nationhood; not an exhaustive standalone Philippine-history course. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Heograpiya.note: AP Grades 7–8: physical/human geography in Southeast Asian and world-history contexts. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Ekonomiks.note: AP Grade 9: economics toward sustainable development; corroborated by DepEd Grade 9 DLP economics materials. Grade 10 p. 70 covers contemporary economic issues, rather than the full Grade 9 economics course. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Sibika at Pamahalaan.note: AP Grades 7–8 historical/political institutions and nationhood; Grade 10 citizenship, rights and civic participation. Broad thematic mapping. Grade 9 pp. 61–63 explicitly covers government and the economy. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Kultura at Lipunan.note: AP Grades 7–8 societies and civilizations; Grade 10 contemporary social issues. This umbrella spans selected thematic units. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Kasalukuyang Pangyayari (Current Events).note: AP Grade 10: contemporary issues. Current events may contextualize other grades, but the catalog tag identifies the principal curriculum placement. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

subject.note: Junior-high coverage of this existing tutoring category. SHS uses distinct courses and electives; Grades 11–12 are not inferred from this JHS label. Cross-checked with the current 2026 BOW. Grades 9–10 share sector BOWs and are specialization-dependent; the listed sources include representative sectors, not a requirement to take every sector.

Computer Basics & ICT.note: EPP/TLE Grade 7 and Grade 8 ICT components; Grade 9/10 ICT specialization is dependent on school offering. Basic computer skills are review within advanced specializations. Cross-checked with the current 2026 BOW. Grades 9–10 share sector BOWs and are specialization-dependent; the listed sources include representative sectors, not a requirement to take every sector.

Home Economics.note: EPP/TLE Grades 7–8 exploratory/family and consumer science content; Grades 9–10 depend on the selected home-economics specialization. Cross-checked with the current 2026 BOW. Grades 9–10 share sector BOWs and are specialization-dependent; the listed sources include representative sectors, not a requirement to take every sector.

Agri-Fishery Arts.note: EPP/TLE Grades 7–8 agriculture/fishery components; Grades 9–10 apply only to the selected agri-fishery specialization. Cross-checked with the current 2026 BOW. Grades 9–10 share sector BOWs and are specialization-dependent; the listed sources include representative sectors, not a requirement to take every sector.

Industrial Arts.note: EPP/TLE Grades 7–8 industrial arts components; Grades 9–10 apply only to the selected industrial specialization. Cross-checked with the current 2026 BOW. Grades 9–10 share sector BOWs and are specialization-dependent; the listed sources include representative sectors, not a requirement to take every sector.

Entrepreneurship.note: EPP/TLE Grade 7 ICT includes qualities of successful entrepreneurs (p. 69); business/career opportunities recur across components and specializations. Embedded theme, not a separate subject at every grade. Cross-checked with the current 2026 BOW. Grades 9–10 share sector BOWs and are specialization-dependent; the listed sources include representative sectors, not a requirement to take every sector.

Music Theory & Appreciation.note: Music and Arts Grades 7–10: musical elements, appreciation and performance in different cultural contexts. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Visual Arts.note: Music and Arts Grades 7–10: visual elements, art analysis and production; themes vary by grade. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Physical Education & Sports.note: PE and Health Grades 7–10: movement, physical activity, fitness and sports with grade-specific activities. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.

Health Education.note: PE and Health Grades 7–10: personal/community health and well-being with grade-specific issues. Cross-checked against the available 2026 three-term Budget of Work for the assigned grades.
